purpose: Predictor-first smoke for a post-hoc action-prefix student on a frozen DINO-WM PushT teacher.

observation_cache_b_arm.consequence: Stage A does not depend on B, does not run E1, and cannot claim full-framework composition.

known_boundary.stage_a_claim: predictor-only DINO-WM PushT capacity, fidelity and latency smoke
stage_a_forbidden_claims: closed-loop success or SOTA is established

C.name: compiled_predictor
C.observation_path: same official raw encode_obs as A

model_contract.anchor_latent: same observed z_t for all prefix horizons
model_contract.action_independent_adapter_accounting: encode once and assign to T_obs

anchors_and_seeds.seed_selection: fixed before execution; no result-dependent replacement
anchors_and_seeds.anchor_scope: capacity/fidelity/latency smoke only, not generalization evaluation

training.target: teacher future latent for each k in 1..H

timing.measurement_unit: one batch of 300 action prefixes from the same cached native anchor latent
timing.path_order: teacher then student within each synchronized repeat
timing.boundary: predictor-level cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through either five-step frozen teacher rollout or one student forward
timing.candidate_schedule: same fixed normalized action-prefix batch for teacher and student
timing.no_double_count_rule: P1 receives encoded z_t and must not include encode_obs; Stage A reports predictor-level timing only and makes no full-plan claim

controls.teacher_identity: repeat P0 with identical z_t, action prefix and seed
controls.causal_future_action: change actions after k and require P1 output at k to remain within tolerance
controls.raw_observation_separation: A/C use the same official raw encode_obs and P1 consumes z_t only

latency.statistic: 1 - median(student predictor time) / median(teacher predictor time)

gates.stage_a_go: capacity and fidelity and latency all pass
gates.stage_a_no_go: any gate fails; do not enter Stage B and do not adjust gates

cache_gate.known_current_result: FAIL: decision gate failed and reduction was 0.04815

future_stage_b.full_framework_claim_allowed: only after B, C and D gates pass

execution_constraints.vpn_failure_policy: pause after consecutive ASPIRE2A access failures; do not restart heavy work automatically
